PTaaS

Veracode Penetration Testing as a Service

Pinpoint complex security gaps to stay ahead of real-world threats and compliance needs with adaptable, hassle-free, regularly-scheduled penetration testing.

Explore Services

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Trusted Expertise

Certified, experienced testers identify real-world risk

Dedicated Testing

Guaranteed testing, never driven by incentives

Flexible Services

Service packages tailored to meet your business needs

What you Need when You Need It

Uncover Exploitable Vulnerabilities Only Humans can Find

Identify Hidden Threats

Automated testing reduces risk, but human expertise adds depth. Our certified testers mimic attacker behavior, adapting to your applications to reveal nuanced issues like business logic flaws.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Conduct more Frequent Tests

Overcome the typical barriers of manual testing—complex scoping, frequent contract negotiations, and steep costs. Veracode allows you to run tests more often to expand your coverage — without the hassle or extra expenses.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Test the Ecosystem, End-to-end

Combine manual penetration testing with Veracode’s application risk management, code-to-cloud scans, AI-powered remediation, on-demand expertise, and integrations for full lifecycle security.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

The Veracode PTaaS advantage

Expert-led Manual Penetration Testing

Elite, industry-trusted testers find real-world security and business risk, and deliver contextual, precise consulting and remediation guidance tailored to your unique security landscape.

   

Specialized Methodologies

Tailored Testing Services

Personalized Consulting

Compliance Support

End-to-end Coverage

      

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Pinpoint Real-world Risk

Our expert, certified testers use industry leading methodologies and advanced tools to conduct real-world attack simulations, finding critical security gaps that only skilled, hands-on professionals can identify and validate.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Testing Aligned with Your Goals

Whether you need a one-time assessment or ongoing testing, Veracode offers flexible testing models and services tailored to your unique risk profile and security objectives.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Expert Support when You Need It

Connect directly with your dedicated tester for an in-depth findings review, answers to your questions, and remediation recommendations.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Stay Ahead of Compliance Requirements

With pre-scheduled manual tests and predictable pricing, our services grow with your needs, helping you keep pace with evolving compliance requirements.

    

                            
                            
                            
                            
                            
                                
                            
                        

Mature your AppSec Program

Combine human expertise and real-world attack simulations with automated static and dynamic analysis, filling critical and complex gaps in your application security program

   

	

		
								

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
										

						

													
					
							
	

Extra Features You’ll Love

Test Like Attackers. Secure Like Experts.

Our core functionality combines real-world risk insight with deep security expertise and tailored consulting, keeping you agile and prepared to meet evolving security and compliance demands.

Consistent Testing

Your dedicated penetration tester will provide guaranteed testing, validated results and personalized consulting.

Automated Scheduling

Set up recurring tests on a customizable schedule to stay ahead of compliance and customer needs.

Predictable Pricing

Flexible pricing models scale with your application’s growth, code updates, and new releases.

Regulatory Compliance

Meet penetration testing compliance requirements for PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and other regulations.

Actionable Results

Get actionable, peer-reviewed feedback with Fix recommendations tailored to your unique security landscape.

Centralized Platform

View results alongside automated security tests to get a holistic, multi-faceted view of your attack surface

Uncover Complex Vulnerabilities with Human Insight

Identify complex vulnerabilities, gain personalized insight, streamline testing processes, ensure compliance and integrate security practices throughout development.
